I have resolved the proxy authentication issue in [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lck03cz7/requests/utils.py#L960-L986) in [utils.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lck03cz7/requests/utils.py).

### Root Cause
`prepend_scheme_if_needed` uses `urllib3.util.parse_url` to parse URLs and obtains `netloc` via `parsed.netloc`. Unlike `urllib.parse.urlparse`, `urllib3`'s `Url.netloc` property only includes `host` and `port` and omits `auth` credentials. Consequently, calling `prepend_scheme_if_needed` on a proxy URL containing basic auth credentials stripped the authentication component before [`HTTPAdapter.proxy_headers`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lck03cz7/requests/adapters.py#L373-L393) extracted them, omitting the `Proxy-Authorization` header and resulting in HTTP `407 Proxy Authentication Required` responses.

### Fix
- Re-attached the `auth` component (when present) to `netloc` in [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lck03cz7/requests/utils.py#L973-L977).
